summary: Schedule a new application instance to launch after the current instance exits.

target.notes: Record a relaunch request; do not implicitly quit the current process.

caveats: A naive Process.Start at call time is observably wrong because Electron launches the replacement after the current instance exits.
args and execPath options alter the relaunch command.

tests.name: relaunch then exit
tests.expected_behavior: a replacement instance starts after the current instance exits

tests.name: does not quit
tests.expected_behavior: the current process keeps running and prints still running until separately exited
